name: io.github.cryptoduke01/gloam
title: Gloam
description: Private stablecoin payments for people and AI agents on mainnet, hosted or local with limits.

tools.name: gloam_info
tools.description: What Gloam is, what this hosted server can do, and where to go to sign or spend. Call this first. This server only reads and plans: it never holds funds and never takes a private key, recovery phrase or note secret.

tools.name: gloam_networks
tools.description: The networks Gloam runs on, mainnets first, with each vault (pool) address, the private swap routers (Robinhood Chain and Tempo mainnet), the assets you can deposit (on mainnet: USDC.e, pathUSD, USDT0 and OUSD on Tempo; USDG, GLOAM, PONS, CASHCAT, ETH, AI and ORBIO on Robinhood Chain; USDC, EURC, USDT and ETH on Base; USDC, USDT, USDG, PYUSD, EURC and ETH on Ethereum; USDC on Elysium, with HYPE and KNTQ once their queued deposit limits land; USDT, USDC (18 decimals each), BNB and BDX on BNB Chain; on testnet: OUSD and PathUSD on Tempo, USDG and ETH on Robinhood Chain, and more on Base Sepolia and Ethereum Sepolia), explorers, RPCs and the testnet faucets. With no network given, also Gloam on Solana (Helius Privacy Rings: in the app, the SDK and the local MCP server), listed apart.

tools.name: gloam_create_payment_request
tools.description: Make a link that asks someone to pay your Gloam address privately. It opens Pay in the Gloam app with the address, amount, asset and note filled in; the payer checks and sends. The details ride after the # of the link, so the payer's browser never sends them to a server. Needs your public Gloam address (gloamr1.…), never a key.

to.description: Your Gloam address to be paid at, gloamr1.… (public; find it in the app under Receive).

amount.description: Amount in whole units, e.g. "12.50". Leave out to let the payer choose.

tools.name: gloam_verify_proof
tools.description: Check a Gloam proof someone shared with you: proof of funds (gloamfunds1:), proof of payment (gloampay1:), payroll total (gloamroll1:) or exact balance (gloambal1:). Runs the same checks as gloam.trade/verify on the server: the zero-knowledge proof, that it was made on Gloam's vault, who it is for, expiry, and the live vault state. The result names the network: `network.testnet` true means the proof was made with test funds, not on mainnet. A proof of payment shows a private payment was made, not who paid whom; a payroll total shows a run of payments the prover funded, not who was paid. The older gloamdisc1 balance disclosure is never verified: anyone can copy one from a public deposit. Proofs are meant to be shared; they hold no secrets.

proof.description: The full proof text, starting gloamfunds1:, gloampay1:, gloamroll1:, gloambal1: or gloamdisc1:.

tools.name: gloam_swap_quote
tools.description: Quote a private swap from a private Gloam balance: what you would get, the route, the vault's fee, and the first thing that would stop the swap (too thin a pool, a refund the vault could not take back, the relay's floor where gas is dear), or none. Read only: it never builds or sends a swap. A private swap hides who swapped; the tokens and amounts are public. To swap, use the Gloam app or the local server (npx -y @gloamtrade/mcp, gloam_execute_private_swap).
